clinic.name: Rejuvenation Dentistry
clinic.heroSubtitle: Achieve a dazzling, camera-ready smile and renew your self-confidence with custom Rejuveneers from Rejuvenation Dentistry. Our porcelain veneers provide a transformative solution for discolored, chipped, or uneven teeth, delivering natural-looking and durable results. Experience a smile makeover that harmonizes aesthetics with your overall well-being, meticulously crafted by our expert team.

treatmentJourney.title: Cosmetic Consultation & Smile Analysis
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a thorough consultation and comprehensive smile analysis. We discuss your aesthetic goals and evaluate your oral health, often utilizing advanced imaging to plan your ideal smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Digital Smile Design Preview
treatmentJourney.description: Using cutting-edge Digital Smile Design, we create a virtual preview of your new smile. You'll see the potential transformation and can collaborate on shade selection and tooth shape before any physical work begins.

treatmentJourney.title: Gentle Preparation & Impressions
treatmentJourney.description: We gently prepare your teeth, removing a minimal amount of enamel to ensure a perfect fit for your veneers. Precise impressions are then taken to guide the custom fabrication process.

treatmentJourney.title: Custom Porcelain Lab Fabrication
treatmentJourney.description: Your custom porcelain veneers are meticulously crafted in a dental lab by skilled artisans. During this period, temporary veneers are placed to protect your teeth and maintain aesthetics.

treatmentJourney.title: Bonding & Final Reveal
treatmentJourney.description: Once your custom veneers are ready, we carefully bond them to your teeth, ensuring a precise fit and natural appearance. This is the exciting moment of your smile's final reveal.

treatmentJourney.title: Follow-Up & Long-Term Care
treatmentJourney.description: We schedule follow-up appointments to ensure your comfort and the success of your new veneers. We'll also provide a personalized long-term care plan, including hygiene tips and any necessary aesthetic touch-ups.

faqItems.question: How long do porcelain veneers last?
faqItems.answer: Porcelain veneers are designed for durability and can last 10-15+ years with proper care and maintenance. Longevity is supported by good oral hygiene and regular dental check-ups.

faqItems.question: How many visits does veneer treatment take?
faqItems.answer: Typically, veneer treatment involves a few visits, from initial consultation and digital design to gentle tooth preparation, temporary placement, and final bonding of custom porcelain veneers.

faqItems.question: Veneers vs. crowns vs. bonding — what's right for me?
faqItems.answer: The best option depends on your specific needs. Veneers are ideal for aesthetic improvements, while crowns are for more significant damage, and bonding is for minor repairs. A consultation will determine the best solution for your smile.

faqItems.question: Will my teeth be ground down for veneers?
faqItems.answer: A minimal amount of enamel reduction is typically required to ensure a proper fit and natural appearance for porcelain veneers. This preparation is gentle and designed to preserve your natural tooth structure.

faqItems.question: Do you offer financing for cosmetic dentistry?
faqItems.answer: While the website doesn't explicitly mention financing, we recommend contacting our office directly to discuss payment options and any available plans for cosmetic treatments.

faqItems.question: Can I see what my new smile will look like first?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we utilize advanced Digital Smile Design to create a preview of your potential new smile. This allows you to visualize and fine-tune your desired aesthetic before treatment begins.

doctor.name: Dr. Gerry Curatola
doctor.bio: Dr. Gerry Curatola, internationally recognized as the "Father of Biologic Dentistry," has redefined dental care over four decades. His pioneering vision integrates oral health with systemic wellness, offering an innovative approach to healing that goes beyond treating symptoms to address root causes. A Clinical Associate Professor at NYU and author of The Mouth-Body Connection™, Dr. Curatola is dedicated to advancing the field through research, education, and practice, making Rejuvenation Dentistry a global leader in biologic and integrative care.
